acceptance: Original archived ASWING outputs. Experiment agreement is optional and not an acceptance blocker.
limitations: Unavailable historical exporter executable/source: selective scaling is independently source-supported, not proven by tracing its implementation.
The manual generic first18 nodal/remaining derived rule is contradicted by nonzero final rear eps/tau. Preserve eps/tau as nodal table observables.

Precise historical spline endpoint derivatives, mesh generation and interior unrounded t values are not recoverable from six-decimal output. Forward root jig Euler angle differs from a natural-spline reconstruction; do not force matching by fitting.

Positive forward joint prints2.000999 although literal anchor is2.001; a simple half-unit rounding interpretation does not encompass that coordinate. Exact known anchors and printed coordinates remain separate.
Forward/rear absolute Euler angles, one-sided local forces and moments must retain mirrored-root orientation and joint sidedness.
General nonflat f_reac projection and nonzero rate conventions are not established by this static snapshot.
Printed half-unit values describe output precision, not an engineering acceptance tolerance; coordinate/model reconstruction limitations must be reported separately.
Global sum moment origin must be independently established before comparing; Xmom alone does not prove the origin of this displayed diagnostic.
diagnostic_model_policy: Drela SEGSPL/SPLIND zero-third-derivative end intervals; two-point segments linear.

source_only_diagnostics.interpretation: Separate fixed-rule source/table calculations. Archived wrenches and angles are inputs, not predicted equilibrium. Scalar uncertainty intervals are not proof of one common unknown station per row.

original_node_endpoint_weight.interpretation: Source specifies unloaded arc length; closer chord total alone does not justify changing ds.

source_only_diagnostics.producer_display_fields: Original parameter-midpoint chord/Cm and scalar weight fields are retained unchanged in meshes; they are not the later uniform display hypotheses.

independent_saved_audit.scope: Independent saved-array and literal-input recovery only. Residual values are audited as retained data, not recomputed physics.
